name: The Golden Banana
style: 2D cartoon animation, bright saturated colors, clean outlines, lush jungle background, consistent character design
script:

Bobo: What a beautiful morning!
Mimi: And I am very hungry.
SCENE: Close-up of Bobo's face as he sniffs the air and smiles.
Bobo: I smell bananas!
